request_summary: TEAMFIX Phase 2 (Duncan queue): CLV-BACKFILL Batch 1 - 11 leagues x 2 seasons (2024-25 + 2023-24), 1x2 FullTime, all bookmakers, scrape + map + INSERT IGNORE into afb_odds_snapshots.
scope_completed: All 22 league-season jobs DONE (11 leagues x 2024-25 + 2023-24)
Total: 3,944 records scraped -> 2,245 mapped (57%) -> 40,201 snapshot rows inserted into afb_odds_snapshots (run_id='clv_backfill_batch1'), DB verified 2,242 distinct matches
Per-league highlights: K League 99% mapping (calendar-year seasons 2025/2024), Serie A 252+171, PL 187+102; J1 via calendar-year seasons 2024/2023 after patch

7 pipeline bugs found and fixed en route (argparse append, scrape timeout 1500->7200s, MIN_RECORDS partial guard, per-worker state files, OH_CHECKPOINT_SAVE=0 checkpoint-overwrite root cause, rc!=0 guard acceptance, calendar-year season mapping)
scripts/clv_backfill.py committed (was never tracked - the earlier 'missing script' issue)

findings.title: Checkpoint wiring was the core data-loss bug
evidence: historic.py wires checkpoint_file_path = -o output path; save_checkpoint overwrites the file with a single record after every match and the final aggregate write is skipped

findings.title: CLI returns rc=1 on partial listing discovery with valid data
evidence: PL 2024-25: rc=1 with 230 valid records; guard updated to accept n>=MIN_RECORDS regardless of rc

findings.title: Mapping no-match rate 43% overall (1,699/3,944)
evidence: La Liga 70%, Copa del Rey 69% no-match: OddsPortal short names vs DB full names - token-subset matcher cannot bridge disjoint names (e.g. 'Bilbao' vs 'Athletic Club')
Unmatched records skipped, never guessed (per spec)

findings.title: Listing-page partial failures cap coverage at ~40-80% per league-season
evidence: 1-4 listing pages failed per season scrape (rc=1 warnings); those matches were never discovered

actions_taken: Ran 22 scrape+map+insert jobs across 3 worker generations (two earlier generations killed after diagnosing output-corruption bugs)
Patched scripts/clv_backfill.py (6 fixes) and src/oddsharvester (sport_league_constants whitelist, coverage_verify candidates)
Verified DB writes: 40,201 rows / 2,242 distinct matches, zero pollution from partial scrapes at any point

verification.evidence: state.json + state-w2.json: 22/22 done (0 failed after retries)
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) -> 40201 / 2242 == pipeline inserted total
J1 2024/2023 + K League 2025/2024 scrapes succeeded with 119-228 mapped per season
57% overall; K League 99%, Serie A/PL healthy; La Liga 22-30% - alias improvement recommended as follow-up

risks: 43% of scraped records unmatched to DB matches - odds for those matches exist in scrape artifacts but are not in DB; alias-table mapping improvement would recover much of it
Listing-page failures leave small per-season discovery gaps (~1-4 pages)
recommended_next_actions: Follow-up task: team-name alias table for OddsPortal short names (would lift mapping rate well above 57%)
Optional: extend backfill to newly-supported competitions from SLUGFIX (UCL/UEL/UECL/EFL Cup/CSL/AFC comps)
CLV analysis can now consume afb_odds_snapshots closing odds for the 11 core leagues
handoff_to_main: TEAMFIX Phase 2 COMPLETE: all 22 league-season jobs done, 3,944 records scraped, 40,201 odds rows inserted (DB verified). 7 pipeline bugs fixed en route (root cause: CLI checkpoint wiring overwrote output with 1 record). scripts/clv_backfill.py committed. Known limitation: 43% mapping no-match rate from name variants - alias table recommended as follow-up.
